## Create a New Repository on GitHub

![](data:image/png;base64,)

## Install Git with Homebrew

```bash
# Install Git
brew install git
```

## Configure SSH and Git

Generate an SSH key locally, then add that SSH key to the SSH key list on GitHub.

```bash
# Configure the global Git identity
git config --global user.name "cc0026"
git config --global user.email "zhuoling_ran@163.com"

# Generate an SSH key
ssh-keygen -t rsa -b 4096 -C "zhuoling_ran@163.com"
pbcopy < ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub   # Copy the public key to the clipboard
```

![](data:image/png;base64,)
![](data:image/png;base64,)

```bash
# Add the SSH key on GitHub, then test the connection
ssh -T git@github.com
```

## Upload Code

```bash
# Add files and commit
git init
git add .
git commit -m "description"

git remote rm origin
git remote add origin git@github.com:cc0026/Jellyfish.git

git branch -M main
git push -u origin main # Push to the remote repository
```

## Update Code

```bash
# For the first time
git clone git@github.com:cc0026/Jellyfish.git
cd Jellyfish

git pull origin main

git add .
git commit -m "update from second computer"

git push origin main
```
